answers.genPolicy:b24a83b44d99dee839b11ca29e4caf:
[B1] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > < deviceA | 'key' : K , ... > $ UserX 'requestKey' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'key' : FreshKey , ... > < deviceA | 'key' : FreshKey , ... > .
[B4] < cloudA | 'secret' : S , deviceA : ('trusted' : (UserX , Users) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'signKey' cloudA | (deviceA ; K)
=> < cloudA | 'secret' : S , deviceA : ('trusted' : (UserX , Users) , ...) , ... > $ cloudA 'sendSignedKey' UserX | (deviceA ; encrypt(K , S)) .
[B4] < UserX | 'signedKey' : nils , ... > $ cloudA 'sendSignedKey' UserX | (deviceA ; M)
=> < UserX | 'signedKey' : M , ... > .
[B5] < UserX | 'signedKey' : M , ... > < deviceA | 'key' : K , 'secret' : S , 'trusted' : Users , ... > $ UserX 'bind' deviceA | (M)
=> < UserX | 'signedKey' : M , ... > < deviceA | 'key' : K , 'secret' : S , 'trusted' : (UserX , Users) , ... > if M == encrypt(K , S) .
[B6] < cloudA | deviceA : ('trusted' : Users , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'share' cloudA | (deviceA ; UserY)
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('trusted' : (UserY , Users) , ...) , ... > .
[B7] < cloudA | deviceA : ('trusted' : (UserX , UserY , Users) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'revoke' cloudA | (deviceA ; UserY)
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('trusted' : (UserX , Users) , ...) , ... > .
